intro: Read formal correspondence, follow its purpose and conditions, and recognise cautious wording.
b1.titulo: Read the purpose and the conditions
b1.texto: Formal messages often follow a predictable path: identify the matter, explain the decision or next step, list any conditions, and close politely. Expressions such as **en relación con**, **se ha recibido** and **quedamos a su disposición** signal a formal register. Pay attention to what the writer promises and what is still pending. A conditional such as **podría** may soften a proposal; it does not necessarily confirm that the action will happen. In the fictional message below, the thirty-day review period is invented for practice; actual deadlines depend on the service and applicable rules. The examples practise reading formal correspondence and do not replace an actual contract or official decision.
b2.f1: Regarding the complaint you submitted on 4 May about the cancellation of your trip, we confirm that we have received the form and proof of payment.
b2.f2: In this fictional example, the documents have been sent to the relevant department, which has an internal period of thirty days to review the case.
b2.f3: If it were necessary to provide any additional information, we would contact you by email.
b2.f4: Once the review is complete, we will inform you of the decision and, if applicable, explain how the refund will be calculated.
b2.f5: This reply confirms receipt of your complaint, but it does not mean that the refund has been approved.
b2.f6: We remain available for any questions and send our kind regards.
b4.o0.refuerzo: The message confirms receipt, not the outcome.
b4.o1.refuerzo: The final decision is still pending.
b5.o0.refuerzo: The refund explanation depends on the review.
b5.o1.refuerzo: The text does not guarantee a refund.
b6.pregunta: Complete: regarding the complaint you submitted…
b6.o0.refuerzo: A formal way to introduce the matter.
b7.pregunta: Why does the writer use «nos pondríamos en contacto»?
b7.o0.refuerzo: The contact depends on whether more information is needed.
b7.o1.refuerzo: The conditional does not report a completed action.
b7.o2.refuerzo: The review is still in progress.
b8.traduccion: We remain available for any questions.
